purpose: Non-authority Inventory preflight for a governed research dispatch that will determine the clearest view system for understanding every part of the Thin Recursive Work Orchestrator design.

primary_targets.claim_ceiling: proposal-only; no runtime implementation or validation proof

selected_precedents.relevance: One authored semantic source can emit separately stored semantic, learner, and navigation views. Removing learner and navigation edges must leave semantic bytes unchanged.
Graph, outline, and table can remain co-primary projections of one immutable snapshot, share stable selection, and feed one provenance inspector.
A learner-only comprehension projection should be separate, authority boundaries must be visible, and browser structure evidence must not be inflated into human comprehension proof.
A regenerable learner projection should preserve separate semantic, evidence, session, workflow, and display-only route records with exact source bindings.
Negative boundary: the repository is an orchestration control plane, not a reasoning engine; the explanatory view must not imply semantic inference authority.

excluded_or_deferred.reason: They concern runtime defects or product presentation details rather than comprehension of this orchestration model.

excluded_or_deferred.class: security fingerprint and browser-neutral digest research
excluded_or_deferred.reason: Useful for future implementation assurance, but it cannot select the explanatory grammar.
It is a rich downstream precedent but would bias the preflight toward a particular existing UI before the research compares view grammars.
The design and ontology are proposal-only; no executable recursive-work runtime exists to observe.

gaps: No machine Inventory exists inside the target cyberalchemy-orchestrator repository.
No external architecture-visualization, information-visualization, or learning-science evidence has yet been collected for this exact design.
No human comprehension study exists for the proposed view.
No browser artifact, visual prototype, accessibility receipt, or performance evidence exists for the proposed view.
The ontology is prose-only and has no machine graph projection yet.
The runtime is unimplemented, so event replay must remain a design walkthrough rather than observed execution.
design_consequences: Do not assume that one large graph is the best explanation.
Compare at least structural anatomy, causal event replay, and learner-centered coordinated-view strategies.
Prefer one semantic source with removable learner and navigation projections over duplicated truth.
Require a visible ownership boundary among orchestrator, work unit, bus, journal, gate decision, and external effects.
Require exact mapping from every design section and ontology cluster to a visual or interaction treatment.
Use finite scenario walkthroughs and misleading-view counterexamples to test non-vacuity.
Separate inspectability, browser correctness, and actual human comprehension claims.
authority_boundary: Inventory is discovery evidence only. The target DESIGN.md and ONTOLOGY.md remain the candidate sources. External sources must be cited directly. Research may recommend a view contract but cannot implement it, promote ontology meaning, change canonical definitions, authorize dispatches, or claim human comprehension.
